title: MobileWorldBench: Towards Semantic World Modeling For Mobile Agents
authors_zh: Shufan Li, Konstantinos Kallidromitis, Akash Gokul, Yusuke Kato, Kazuki Kozuka, Aditya Grover
paper_type_zh: 移动GUI单步语义世界模型数据集与离线混合反馈基准
best_for_zh: 研究移动智能体SFT数据、next-state预测、VLM judge与离线评测审计的读者
one_line: MobileWorldBench evaluates one-step Android future-state semantics with GPT-judged descriptions and yes/no QA, while MobileWorld supplies roughly 1.4M model-annotated transition items for SFT.
MobileWorldBench把移动智能体行为压缩为离线单步state/action/next-state预测，并以GPT-4o rubric和Yes/No准确率混合评测；MobileWorld另供SFT数据，但split、图像完整性、judge版本、许可与隐私仍有缺口。
why: It isolates the predictive component of mobile-agent reasoning into auditable state/action/next-state records, but also shows why source trajectories do not imply episode supervision and why judge versions, split hashes, replay support, licenses, and annotation lineage matter before reuse.
inclusion_reason: MobileWorldBench makes one-step semantic state prediction and its mixed feedback contract explicit for mobile-agent reasoning: human demonstration transitions become textual future-state supervision, rubric-judged generation, and exact yes/no evaluation, while the offline release exposes important boundaries around episode semantics, replay, split verification, and artifact rights.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The canonical source is the 2025 arXiv paper, supplemented by the official MobileWorld repository, MobileWorld and mobileworldbench Hugging Face datasets, and released Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-MobileWorld-SFT model at the revisions pinned in paper.yaml. The paper separates two products: MobileWorldBench is an offline evaluation benchmark, while MobileWorld is a model-annotated training release for supervised fine-tuning.

The paper targets a narrow component of mobile-agent reasoning: predicting the semantic result of one action from the current Android screenshot. The atomic record is a single state/action/next-state transition, not a complete episode. Next-State-Generation maps current screenshot plus natural-language action to a short description of expected UI changes; Next-State-QA asks a Yes/No fact about the next state. Source records come from human demonstrations in Android Control and Android in the Wild, but the released benchmark does not execute actions or expose a live device.

MobileWorldBench samples 250 generation transitions and 500 QA transitions. The released repository contains 250 generation rows and 1,787 retained QA rows. One generation row references two absent screenshots, so only 249 of 250 generation rows are image-complete in the audited official benchmark-image snapshot. MobileWorld is described as roughly 1.4M training items—rounded components of 543k QA pairs and 942k descriptions—and is distributed as three Parquet members inside one tar archive.

This work belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data only at transition level: it serializes observation, action, predicted next-state semantics, and feedback, but provides no full action sequence, environment transition API, reset/replay contract, or terminal success predicate. The bilingual body is prepared at L4 review depth while canonical metadata remains L3_summary_ready; supported uses are SFT and evaluation only.

本卡以2025年arXiv论文为规范来源，并辅以paper.yaml所固定版本的官方MobileWorld仓库、MobileWorld与mobileworldbench Hugging Face数据集，以及发布的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct-MobileWorld-SFT模型。论文区分两类产物：MobileWorldBench是离线evaluation benchmark，MobileWorld则是用于supervised fine-tuning的模型标注训练发布。

论文针对移动智能体推理中的一个窄组件：根据当前Android screenshot预测一个action的语义结果。原子记录是单个state/action/next-state transition，不是完整episode。Next-State-Generation把当前screenshot与自然语言action映射为预期UI变化的短描述；Next-State-QA询问关于下一状态的Yes/No事实。源记录来自Android Control与Android in the Wild的人类demonstration，但发布的benchmark不执行action，也不提供live device。

MobileWorldBench抽样250个generation transition和500个QA transition。发布仓库包含250个generation row与1,787个保留QA row。一条generation row引用的两张screenshot均缺失，因此检查到的官方benchmark-image snapshot中只有249/250个generation row图像完整。MobileWorld被描述为约1.4M个训练item——四舍五入的组成是543k QA pair与942k description——并以一个tar archive中的三个Parquet member分发。

本文只在transition层面属于environment_agent_trajectory_data：它序列化observation、action、预测的next-state semantics与反馈，但不提供完整action sequence、environment transition API、reset/replay契约或terminal success predicate。双语正文达到待人工审核的L4内容深度，canonical metadata保持L3_summary_ready；证据仅支持SFT与evaluation用途。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MobileWorldBench's core idea is to isolate semantic world modeling from full agent control. Given a static current screenshot and a natural-language rendering of one human action, a model either generates the expected state change or answers a binary question about the next state. The source next screenshot is used to construct references and, for generation scoring, is visible to the judge; the evaluated model does not interact with the app or receive a multi-step history.

The feedback contract is mixed. For Next-State-Generation, a GPT-4o judge compares the prediction with the ground-truth next screenshot and reference change description, assigning 1–5 scores for accuracy, completeness, and relevance, with an overall total out of 15. For Next-State-QA, programmatic evaluation computes exact Yes/No answer accuracy. Human pairwise comparisons over 3,000 sampled model-output matches are additional analysis, not the primary released metric.

This feedback can observe semantic agreement with a reference transition and binary factual correctness. It cannot verify an executed environment outcome, long-horizon recovery, safety, or terminal task completion. There is no episode terminal predicate: each independent row ends after one predicted description or Yes/No answer. AndroidWorld appears only in a separate downstream planning experiment and must not be projected onto the benchmark's released feedback contract.

Relative to complete mobile-agent trajectories, the contribution is a compact transition-level prediction target that can be scaled into SFT data and evaluated offline. Relative to image-only future-frame prediction, it makes action-conditioned semantic text the target. The closest internal comparison is between MobileWorldBench evaluation rows and MobileWorld training annotations: they share the one-step object but differ in source portions, filtering, scale, and human review. Missing record-level split IDs prevent independently verifying zero overlap.

MobileWorldBench的核心思想是把semantic world modeling从完整agent control中分离出来。给定静态current screenshot和一次人类action的自然语言描述，模型要么生成预期state change，要么回答关于next state的二元问题。source next screenshot用于构造reference，并在generation评分时对judge可见；被评模型不与app交互，也不接收多步history。

反馈契约是mixed。对Next-State-Generation，GPT-4o judge把prediction与ground-truth next screenshot及reference change description比较，分别给accuracy、completeness与relevance打1–5分，总分最高15。对Next-State-QA，程序化评测计算精确Yes/No answer accuracy。对3,000个抽样model-output match进行的人类pairwise comparison属于附加分析，不是主要发布metric。

该反馈能观察与reference transition的语义一致性和二元事实正确性，却不能验证已执行的environment outcome、long-horizon recovery、安全或terminal task completion。系统没有episode terminal predicate：每条独立记录在输出一次description或Yes/No answer后结束。AndroidWorld只出现在另行开展的downstream planning实验中，不能反推为benchmark的发布反馈契约。

相对完整mobile-agent trajectory，本文贡献是一个紧凑的transition-level prediction target，可扩展为SFT数据并离线评测；相对仅预测future frame，它以action-conditioned semantic text为target。最接近的内部对照是MobileWorldBench evaluation row与MobileWorld training annotation：二者共享单步对象，但source portion、filtering、scale与human review不同。缺少逐记录split ID使零重叠无法独立核验。

title: Method
方法
html:
Source transitions and benchmark construction. Current/action/next screenshot triplets are sampled from human demonstrations in Android Control and AiTW. For generation, 250 transitions are selected, their action descriptions are human checked, and all 250 are retained. For QA, 500 source transitions yield 4,000 machine-generated candidates; GPT-4o self-check/relevance filtering leaves 2,458, and qualified Mechanical Turk correctness, relevance, and ambiguity filtering leaves 1,787. The released qa.csv contains 1,162 Yes and 625 No labels but omits source dataset, source split, next screenshot, annotator, and filter-decision fields.

MobileWorld training construction. Training transitions come from the source training portions of AiTW and Android Control. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct annotates 90% and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B annotates 10%. Three state-change descriptions and eight QA candidates are generated per transition with before/action/after evidence. A VLM selects the best description under accuracy/completeness/relevance; QA candidates undergo self-check and relevance filtering. Unlike benchmark QA, the MobileWorld training annotations are not human-filtered. The reported rounded totals are about 543k QA pairs plus 942k descriptions, summarized as 1.4M items.

SFT recipe. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is fine-tuned for two epochs with AdamW, batch size 128, 1280px images, 6% warmup, and cosine scheduling. The rendered paper does not expose a usable learning-rate value; training-annotation decoding parameters, token limits, random seeds, and checkpoint selection are unknown. The official training archive contains three Parquet members inside mobileworld.tar, but has no dataset card or exact transparent 1.4M-row manifest.

Evaluation. Each row requires one model call. Generation adds one proprietary judge call using the current/next screenshot, reference description, prediction, and rubric. The paper specifies gpt-4o-2024-08-06, while scripts/score_gpt4o.py defaults to gpt-4o-mini when no judge configuration is supplied; exact reproduction therefore requires an explicit model/config pin. QA uses temperature 0.0 and exact Yes/No accuracy; generation uses each model's default sampling parameters.

Release and replay boundary. Evaluation reads CSV rows and static screenshots. No emulator snapshot, executable action, app fixture, reset routine, full source trajectory, or deterministic replay interface is released. At benchmark-image revision 8a9e39c5f09cf63e9b16fd3ad47cf4eb23adaf13, one gen.csv row lacks both expected images, leaving 249/250 generation rows runnable. Reproduction should pin all repository/data/model revisions, image hashes, judge prompt/parser/model/retry configuration, model decoding, and split IDs; several of those fields remain unknown.

源transition与benchmark构造。 current/action/next screenshot triplet从Android Control与AiTW的人类demonstration中抽样。generation选择250个transition，对action description进行人工检查，并保留全部250个。QA从500个source transition生成4,000个machine-generated candidate；经GPT-4o self-check/relevance filtering剩2,458个，再由合格Mechanical Turk worker按correctness、relevance与ambiguity过滤为1,787个。发布的qa.csv含1,162个Yes与625个No label，但省略source dataset、source split、next screenshot、annotator与filter-decision字段。

MobileWorld训练构造。 训练transition来自AiTW与Android Control的source training portion。Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct标注90%，Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B标注10%。每个transition使用before/action/after证据生成三个state-change description和八个QA candidate。VLM按accuracy/completeness/relevance选择最佳description；QA candidate经过self-check和relevance filtering。与benchmark QA不同，MobileWorld训练annotation未经人工过滤。报告的四舍五入总量约为543k QA pair加942k description，汇总称1.4M items。

SFT recipe。 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct用AdamW微调两个epoch，batch size 128、image 1280px、6% warmup与cosine schedule。渲染论文没有提供可用learning-rate值；training-annotation decoding parameter、token limit、random seed与checkpoint selection均为unknown。官方训练archive在mobileworld.tar内包含三个Parquet member，但没有dataset card或透明的精确1.4M-row manifest。

评测。 每条记录需要一次model call。generation再增加一次proprietary judge call，输入current/next screenshot、reference description、prediction与rubric。论文指定gpt-4o-2024-08-06，而未提供judge配置时，scripts/score_gpt4o.py默认使用gpt-4o-mini；精确复现因此必须显式固定model/config。QA使用temperature 0.0和精确Yes/No accuracy；generation使用各模型默认sampling parameter。

发布与replay边界。 evaluation读取CSV row和静态screenshot。发布不含emulator snapshot、可执行action、app fixture、reset routine、完整source trajectory或deterministic replay接口。在benchmark-image revision 8a9e39c5f09cf63e9b16fd3ad47cf4eb23adaf13上，一条gen.csv记录缺少两张预期图片，因此只有249/250个generation row可运行。复现应固定全部repository/data/model revision、image hash、judge prompt/parser/model/retry配置、模型decoding与split ID；其中多项仍为unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All model results are author-reported and were not independently reproduced. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on MobileWorld increases MobileWorldBench generation overall from 11.84 to 12.39 and QA accuracy from 67.32 to 71.40 (Paper Tables 1–2). These gains are conditional on the released annotation pipeline, two-epoch SFT recipe, benchmark prompts, judge version, and model decoding. They do not prove that every transition label is correct or that the data represents complete agent behavior.

In the separate downstream AndroidWorld experiment, success is 46.9 for the baseline, 50.8 with zero-shot semantic world modeling, and 54.3 with the fine-tuned world model (Paper Table 3). The planner proposes eight actions, predicts their semantic next states, and scores them with a VLM value model. This result supports planning utility for a learned one-step predictor, but AndroidWorld is an online downstream experiment—not MobileWorldBench's released environment or feedback contract.

Release-level counts are directly auditable. benchmark/gen.csv has 250 rows and benchmark/qa.csv has 1,787 rows, including 1,162 Yes and 625 No labels. The official benchmark-image snapshot lists 958 files, but both expected images for the generation row at google_apps/episode_12551800716657978063/step_2363_raw.jpg and step_2364_raw.jpg are absent. Therefore 249 of 250 generation rows have both images, and the affected row has neither.

The construction funnel is also explicit: 500 QA source transitions produce 4,000 candidates, GPT-4o filtering leaves 2,458, and human filtering leaves 1,787. For generation, action descriptions for all 250 sampled transitions are human checked and retained. These checks document selection stages, but the released QA CSV omits record-level source/split/annotator/filter provenance, and no error rate for generation references or GPT-4o rubric judgments is reported.

Reproduction evidence exposes a judge-version confound. The paper identifies gpt-4o-2024-08-06; the released scoring script defaults to gpt-4o-mini without explicit configuration. Scores generated by those settings should not be treated as interchangeable. Human pairwise comparison over 3,000 sampled output matches is supportive analysis, but does not replace a fixed, independently calibrated evaluator.

以下模型结果均为作者报告，尚未独立复现。在MobileWorld上微调Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct后，MobileWorldBench generation overall从11.84提升到12.39，QA accuracy从67.32提升到71.40（论文表1–2）。这些增益取决于发布的annotation pipeline、两epoch SFT recipe、benchmark prompt、judge版本与模型decoding，不能证明每条transition label正确，也不能说明数据代表完整agent behavior。

在另行开展的downstream AndroidWorld实验中，baseline success为46.9，使用zero-shot semantic world modeling为50.8，使用fine-tuned world model为54.3（论文表3）。planner提出八个action、预测其semantic next state，并用VLM value model评分。该结果支持学习到的单步predictor用于planning，但AndroidWorld是在线downstream实验，并非MobileWorldBench发布的环境或反馈契约。

发布层数量可以直接审计。benchmark/gen.csv有250行，benchmark/qa.csv有1,787行，其中1,162个Yes、625个No。官方benchmark-image snapshot列出958个文件，但generation row google_apps/episode_12551800716657978063/step_2363_raw.jpg与step_2364_raw.jpg对应的两张图片均缺失。因此249/250个generation row同时具有两张图片，受影响记录一张也没有。

构造funnel同样明确：500个QA source transition生成4,000个candidate，经GPT-4o过滤剩2,458个，再经人工过滤剩1,787个。generation中，250个抽样transition的action description全部经人工检查并保留。这些检查记录了selection stage，但发布QA CSV省略逐记录source/split/annotator/filter provenance，也未报告generation reference或GPT-4o rubric judgment的错误率。

复现证据暴露judge-version混杂。论文指定gpt-4o-2024-08-06，发布评分脚本在没有显式配置时默认gpt-4o-mini。这两种设置产生的分数不能视为可互换。对3,000个抽样output match的人类pairwise comparison提供辅助分析，但不能替代固定且独立校准的evaluator。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline object is a full mobile demonstration trajectory: screenshots and human actions unfold over an episode toward task completion. MobileWorldBench deliberately changes the object to independent one-step transitions and asks for semantic future-state prediction. This makes state/action supervision easier to serialize and evaluate offline, while removing the environment, history, recovery behavior, and terminal success that characterize full agent trajectories.

A second change is the paired evaluation interface. Free-form Next-State-Generation uses three-dimensional GPT-4o rubric feedback, while Next-State-QA uses exact Yes/No accuracy. The benchmark therefore exposes how a learned semantic judge and a programmatic binary check behave on two views of the same transition-prediction problem. Neither channel is an environmental verifier, and the learned side inherits model/prompt/version dependence.

MobileWorld extends the same one-step object into a large SFT construction recipe: Qwen3-VL annotators generate multiple candidate descriptions and QA pairs with access to before/action/after evidence, then VLM filters select outputs; benchmark QA adds Mechanical Turk filtering. The useful direction signal is the explicit separation among human source demonstrations, synthetic semantic annotations, offline benchmark targets, and downstream AndroidWorld planning.

The work does not newly introduce screenshots, action descriptions, VLM annotation, SFT, Yes/No QA, or LLM-as-judge evaluation. The 1.4M headline and benchmark improvements are scale/result claims, not record-quality certificates. Before reuse, one must audit the missing generation images, exact Parquet counts/schema, source/split IDs, decontamination hashes, failed/no-change retention, judge configuration, artifact licenses, privacy/consent, and third-party screenshot rights.

最接近的baseline对象是完整mobile demonstration trajectory：screenshot与人类action沿episode展开，最终指向任务完成。MobileWorldBench有意把对象改成彼此独立的单步transition，并要求预测semantic future state。这使state/action监督更易序列化和离线评测，同时移除了完整agent trajectory所包含的environment、history、recovery behavior与terminal success。

第二项变化是成对的evaluation接口。自由形式Next-State-Generation使用三维GPT-4o rubric反馈，Next-State-QA使用精确Yes/No accuracy。因此benchmark在同一transition-prediction问题的两种视图上展示learned semantic judge与programmatic binary check。两种反馈都不是environmental verifier，而learned一侧还依赖model/prompt/version。

MobileWorld把同一单步对象扩展为大型SFT构造recipe：Qwen3-VL annotator访问before/action/after证据，生成多个candidate description与QA pair，再由VLM filter选择输出；benchmark QA另加Mechanical Turk过滤。其方向价值是明确分开human source demonstration、synthetic semantic annotation、offline benchmark target与downstream AndroidWorld planning。

本文并未新提出screenshot、action description、VLM annotation、SFT、Yes/No QA或LLM-as-judge evaluation。1.4M headline与benchmark提升属于规模/结果声称，不是逐记录质量认证。复用前必须审计缺失generation image、精确Parquet count/schema、source/split ID、decontamination hash、failed/no-change保留、judge配置、artifact许可、privacy/consent与第三方screenshot权利。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Object boundary: Released records are offline one-step transitions. They cannot evaluate action execution, multi-step planning, recovery, environment drift, reset reliability, or terminal task success, and must not be described as complete episodes or an executable environment.
  • Judge dependence: Generation scoring relies on a proprietary VLM and prompt parsing, with risks from verbosity, hallucination, rubric drift, API drift, and nondeterminism. The paper uses gpt-4o-2024-08-06, while the script defaults to gpt-4o-mini; unpinned use changes the feedback contract.
  • Benchmark completeness: One of 250 generation rows lacks both required images in the official snapshot, leaving only 249 image-complete rows. QA labels are imbalanced at 1,162 Yes versus 625 No, so aggregate accuracy can conceal answer-prior behavior unless per-class metrics are reported.
  • Split and contamination: The paper states training-source versus held-out/test-source separation, but QA rows omit source/split fields and no immutable transition IDs, screenshot/text hashes, deduplication report, evaluated-model exposure audit, or post-release contamination policy is released. Public references make leakage straightforward.
  • Failure retention: Annotation prompts allow failed actions or no observed change, but their prevalence, balance, candidate rejection, and kept/discarded decisions are undisclosed. There are no episode-success labels or released complete source trajectories, so failure retention cannot be inferred from row counts.
  • Synthetic annotation quality: 90% of MobileWorld uses Qwen3-VL-8B annotations and 10% Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B; training descriptions/QA are VLM-filtered without human filtering. Correlated annotator errors, judge preferences, and Qwen-family priors can survive selection.
  • Release transparency: The 184 MB training tar contains three Parquet members without a dataset card, exact row manifest, complete schemas, source IDs, or candidate/filter lineage. Rounded components 543k + 942k equal about 1.485M, so the “1.4M” headline is not an exact release count.
  • Replay and reproduction: No emulator/device snapshot, app fixture, executable action trace, reset routine, or deterministic replay contract exists. Exact learning rate, annotation decoding, token budget, seeds, checkpoint selection, judge retries, and API snapshot are unknown.
  • License and privacy: Only the paper's CC BY 4.0 license is verified. Code, datasets, screenshots, annotations, and model weights have no confirmed artifact license; source mobile screenshots also lack MobileWorld-specific consent, PII/account-content filtering, takedown, and redistribution-rights disclosures.

• 对象边界： 发布记录是离线单步transition。它们不能评测action execution、multi-step planning、recovery、environment drift、reset reliability或terminal task success，不能被描述为完整episode或可执行环境。
  • judge依赖： generation评分依赖proprietary VLM和prompt parsing，存在verbosity、hallucination、rubric drift、API drift与nondeterminism风险。论文使用gpt-4o-2024-08-06，脚本默认gpt-4o-mini；未固定配置会改变反馈契约。
  • benchmark完整性： 官方snapshot中250个generation row有一个缺失两张必要图片，只有249个图像完整。QA label为1,162个Yes对625个No，类别不平衡；若不报告per-class metric，aggregate accuracy可能掩盖answer-prior行为。
  • split与污染： 论文声明training-source与held-out/test-source分离，但QA row省略source/split字段，也未发布不可变transition ID、screenshot/text hash、deduplication report、evaluated-model exposure audit或post-release contamination政策。公开reference使泄漏容易发生。
  • 失败保留： annotation prompt允许failed action或未观察到变化，但其占比、balance、candidate rejection和kept/discarded decision均未披露。没有episode-success label或发布的完整source trajectory，因此不能从row count推断failure retention。
  • 合成标注质量： MobileWorld的90%使用Qwen3-VL-8B annotation，10%使用Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B；训练description/QA经VLM filtering但未经人工过滤。相关annotator error、judge preference与Qwen-family prior可能在selection后保留。
  • 发布透明度： 184 MB训练tar含三个Parquet member，但没有dataset card、精确row manifest、完整schema、source ID或candidate/filter lineage。四舍五入组成543k + 942k约等于1.485M，因此“1.4M”headline不是精确发布计数。
  • replay与复现： 不存在emulator/device snapshot、app fixture、可执行action trace、reset routine或deterministic replay契约。精确learning rate、annotation decoding、token budget、seed、checkpoint selection、judge retry与API snapshot均为unknown。
  • 许可与隐私： 只有论文CC BY 4.0许可已核验。code、dataset、screenshot、annotation与model weight均无已确认artifact license；源mobile screenshot也缺少MobileWorld-specific consent、PII/account-content filtering、takedown与redistribution-rights披露。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, MobileWorldBench provides a controlled way to study one transition without pretending to release an episode. A reusable row should bind source dataset/split/transition ID, current and next image hashes, natural-language action, reference change description or Yes/No target, generator identity/configuration, candidate set, filter decisions, judge model/prompt/parser, and missing-image status. Those fields would make state/action supervision auditable across MobileWorld and MobileWorldBench.

For SFT, MobileWorld supplies action-conditioned future-state descriptions and QA targets that can train a model to verbalize likely GUI changes. The demonstrated recipe fine-tunes Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct for two epochs. Reusers should first recover exact Parquet schemas/counts, verify source-image rights and licenses, separate benchmark/test transitions by immutable hashes, record failed/no-change examples, and measure annotator/judge correlation. This is transition-prediction SFT, not full agent-trajectory training.

For evaluation, use both channels and preserve their distinct contracts. Report generation's accuracy, completeness, relevance, total score, judge version, prompt/parser, retry policy, and sampling configuration; report QA overall and per-class accuracy because Yes/No labels are imbalanced. Exclude or repair the row missing both images, and explicitly configure gpt-4o-2024-08-06 if reproducing the paper rather than accepting the script's gpt-4o-mini default.

The static benchmark can support ablations on action representations, semantic versus visual prediction, judge stability, and best-of-three filtering. AndroidWorld results can motivate downstream planning experiments with predicted next states, but a live environment, reset protocol, action executor, and terminal success metric must be supplied separately. MobileWorldBench itself cannot measure those properties.

Current reuse classification is SFT and evaluation only. RL, reward-model training, full agent-episode training, or unrestricted redistribution is not supported by the verified release. Missing split hashes, decontamination, failure-retention statistics, exact manifests, artifact licenses, privacy/consent review, and judge pins remain blockers to stronger reuse claims.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data而言，MobileWorldBench提供了一种研究单个transition的受控方式，而不把它误写为已发布episode。可复用row应绑定source dataset/split/transition ID、current与next image hash、自然语言action、reference change description或Yes/No target、generator身份/配置、candidate set、filter decision、judge model/prompt/parser及missing-image状态。这些字段可使MobileWorld与MobileWorldBench之间的state/action监督可审计。

用于SFT时，MobileWorld提供action-conditioned future-state description与QA target，可训练模型表述可能的GUI变化。已演示recipe对Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct微调两个epoch。复用者应先恢复精确Parquet schema/count，核验source-image权利与许可，以不可变hash分隔benchmark/test transition，记录failed/no-change example，并测量annotator/judge相关性。这是transition-prediction SFT，不是完整agent-trajectory training。

用于evaluation时，应同时使用两种channel并保留各自契约。generation需报告accuracy、completeness、relevance、总分、judge版本、prompt/parser、retry policy与sampling配置；QA因Yes/No label不平衡，应报告总体与per-class accuracy。应排除或修复缺失两张图片的row；若复现论文，应显式配置gpt-4o-2024-08-06，不能接受脚本默认的gpt-4o-mini。

该静态benchmark可支持action representation、semantic versus visual prediction、judge stability与best-of-three filtering的ablation。AndroidWorld结果可提示使用预测next state开展downstream planning实验，但必须另行提供live environment、reset protocol、action executor与terminal success metric；MobileWorldBench本身不能测量这些性质。

当前复用分类是仅限SFT与evaluation。已核验发布不支持RL、reward-model training、完整agent-episode training或不受限再分发。缺少split hash、decontamination、failure-retention统计、精确manifest、artifact许可、privacy/consent review与judge固定，仍阻止更强复用声称。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with the object boundary: one static current screenshot plus one action predicts next-state text or a Yes/No fact; there is no complete episode, executable environment, reset, or terminal success.
  • Keep MobileWorldBench and MobileWorld separate: the former evaluates 250 generation transitions and 1,787 retained QA items, while the latter provides roughly 1.4M model-annotated items for SFT.
  • Audit image completeness before scoring: only 249/250 generation rows have both referenced screenshots in the pinned official snapshot.
  • Pin the judge: the paper specifies gpt-4o-2024-08-06, but the released scoring script defaults to gpt-4o-mini without explicit configuration.
  • Interpret mixed feedback correctly: generation uses GPT-4o accuracy/completeness/relevance scores; QA uses exact Yes/No accuracy and has 1,162 Yes versus 625 No labels.
  • Before reuse, verify split hashes, deduplication/decontamination, failed/no-change retention, Parquet manifests, licenses, privacy/consent, and third-party screenshot rights.

• 先明确对象边界：一个静态current screenshot加一个action，用于预测next-state text或Yes/No事实；不存在完整episode、可执行环境、reset或terminal success。
  • 区分MobileWorldBench与MobileWorld：前者评测250个generation transition和1,787个保留QA item，后者提供约1.4M个模型标注item用于SFT。
  • 评分前审计图像完整性：固定官方snapshot中只有249/250个generation row同时具备两张引用screenshot。
  • 固定judge：论文指定gpt-4o-2024-08-06，发布评分脚本在无显式配置时默认gpt-4o-mini。
  • 正确理解mixed feedback：generation使用GPT-4o accuracy/completeness/relevance分数；QA使用精确Yes/No accuracy，label为1,162个Yes对625个No。
  • 复用前核验split hash、deduplication/decontamination、failed/no-change保留、Parquet manifest、许可、privacy/consent与第三方screenshot权利。

value.html: Offline Android screenshots extracted from AiTW and Android Control human demonstrations. MobileWorldBench is not a resettable app/device environment and provides no executable episode state. AndroidWorld appears only as a separate downstream online experiment.

value.html: Generation predictions are scored by a GPT-4o judge on accuracy, completeness, and relevance (1-5 each; overall out of 15). QA is scored by yes/no answer accuracy. Human pairwise comparisons over 3,000 sampled model-output matches provide an additional analysis, not the primary released metric.

value_zh.html: 生成预测由 GPT-4o 评审按准确性、完整性与相关性打分（各项 1-5；总分满分 15）。QA 按是/否答案准确性打分。对 3,000 条采样模型输出匹配的人类成对比较提供额外分析，而非主要发布指标。

value.html: No episode terminal predicate exists. Each independent transition ends after one predicted next-state description or yes/no answer; generation feedback is the parsed judge score and QA feedback is answer correctness.

value.html: Human mobile demonstration transition -> high-level action annotation -> candidate descriptions/QA generated with next-state access -> VLM filtering and, for benchmark QA, human filtering -> static CSV plus image or Parquet release -> model prediction -> rubric judge or answer-accuracy score.

value.html: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is the demonstrated SFT base model.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 是所展示的 SFT 基座模型。

value.html: Three state-change descriptions and eight QA candidates are generated per source transition using the before/action/after evidence.

value_zh.html: 使用之前/动作/之后证据，每个来源转移生成三条状态变化描述与八个 QA 候选。

value.html: Human demonstration transitions from the training portions of AiTW and Android Control for MobileWorld, and benchmark/test-source transitions for MobileWorldBench. Exact record-level source IDs are not released in all benchmark files.

value_zh.html: MobileWorld 使用来自 AiTW 与 Android Control 训练部分的人类示范转移，MobileWorldBench 使用基准/测试来源转移。并非所有基准文件都发布精确的记录级来源 ID。

value.html: MobileWorldBench samples 250 transitions for generation and 500 for QA, creates 4,000 QA candidates, VLM-filters to 2,458, and human-filters to 1,787. MobileWorld reports approximately 543k QA pairs and 942k descriptions; source-transition count, random seeds, and sampling shares are undisclosed.

value_zh.html: MobileWorldBench 为生成采样 250 条转移、为 QA 采样 500 条，创建 4,000 个 QA 候选，经 VLM 过滤至 2,458，经人工过滤至 1,787。MobileWorld 报告约 543k 对 QA 与 942k 条描述；来源转移计数、随机种子与采样份额未披露。

value.html: Not applicable as full agent rollouts: released objects are independent one-step transitions. The paper reports about 1.4M final training items, with rounded components 543k QA plus 942k descriptions.

value_zh.html: 不适用于完整智能体 rollouts：已发布对象为独立单步转移。论文报告约 1.4M 条最终训练条目，圆整分量为 543k QA 加 942k 条描述。

value.html: Training-annotation decoding is unknown. Benchmark Next-State-QA evaluation uses temperature 0.0; generation evaluation uses each model's default sampling parameters.

value.html: For descriptions, a VLM judge chooses the best of three under accuracy, completeness, and relevance. QA candidates undergo self-check and relevance filtering; benchmark QA additionally removes human-disagreed, irrelevant, or ambiguous items. MobileWorld training annotations are not human-filtered.

value_zh.html: 对描述，VLM 评审按准确性、完整性与相关性从三条中选出最佳。QA 候选经过自检与相关性过滤；基准 QA 额外移除人类不同意、不相关或含糊的条目。MobileWorld 训练标注未经人工过滤。

value.html: One model call per benchmark row, plus one judge call per generation prediction. Fine-tuning uses two epochs, batch size 128, 1280px images, 6% warmup, and a cosine schedule; token limits and usable learning-rate values are undisclosed.

value_zh.html: 每条基准行一次模型调用，外加每次生成预测一次评审调用。微调使用两个 epochs、batch size 128、1280px 图像、6% warmup 与余弦调度；token 限制与可用学习率值未披露。

value.html: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is SFT-trained with AdamW. Downstream AndroidWorld planning proposes eight actions, predicts semantic next states, and scores them with a VLM value model; this planner is not the benchmark data object.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 用 AdamW 进行 SFT 训练。下游 AndroidWorld 规划提出八个动作、预测语义下一状态，并用 VLM 价值模型打分；该规划器不是基准数据对象。

value.html: Android Control and AiTW human-demonstration transitions. Training annotations mix 90% Qwen3-VL-8B and 10% Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B output. The benchmark mixes 250 generation transitions with 1,787 retained QA items from 500 transitions and covers 22 apps and four broad task categories.

value_zh.html: Android Control 与 AiTW 人类示范转移。训练标注混合 90% Qwen3-VL-8B 与 10% Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 输出。基准将 250 条生成转移与来自 500 条转移的 1,787 条保留 QA 条目混合，覆盖 22 个应用与四个宽泛任务类别。

value.html: The paper distinguishes MobileWorld source training transitions from MobileWorldBench held-out/test-source transitions. However, benchmark/qa.csv omits source-dataset and split fields, no immutable transition-ID manifest or dev split is published, and the HF training archive exposes only a generic train split.

value_zh.html: 论文区分 MobileWorld 来源训练转移与 MobileWorldBench 留出/测试来源转移。然而，benchmark/qa.csv 省略来源数据集与划分字段，未发布不可变的转移 ID 清单或 dev 划分，且 HF 训练归档仅暴露通用 train 划分。

value.html: The paper asserts source train-versus-test separation, but the release does not supply record-level cross-split IDs or hashes needed to verify zero overlap. Generated annotations may also share annotator-model priors with evaluated Qwen-family models.

value_zh.html: 论文主张来源训练相对测试分离，但发布未提供核验零重叠所需的记录级跨划分 ID 或哈希。生成的标注也可能与被评测的 Qwen 系列模型共享标注器模型先验。

value.html: No evaluated-model pretraining overlap audit, screenshot/text deduplication report, benchmark-to-training hash comparison, or post-release contamination policy is reported. Public benchmark CSVs and reference fields create direct evaluation-contamination risk.

value_zh.html: 未报告被评测模型的预训练重叠审计、截图/文本去重报告、基准到训练的哈希比较或发布后污染政策。公开基准 CSV 与参考字段造成直接评测污染风险。

value.html: The annotation prompt allows descriptions of failed actions or no observed change, but neither paper nor release reports their prevalence, balancing, kept/rejected counts, or record-level decisions. No episode success/failure labels or complete source trajectories are released.

value_zh.html: 标注提示允许描述失败动作或无观察到的变化，但论文与发布均未报告其出现率、平衡、保留/拒绝计数或记录级决定。未发布 episode 成功/失败标签或完整来源轨迹。

items: The official benchmark-image snapshot lacks both images for one benchmark/gen.csv row (episode_12551800716657978063, steps 2363 and 2364), leaving only 249 of 250 generation rows image-complete.

Generation scores depend on a proprietary VLM judge and prompt parsing; the paper specifies gpt-4o-2024-08-06, while the released scoring script defaults to gpt-4o-mini unless a judge config is supplied.
The generation judge is vulnerable to verbosity, hallucination, rubric drift, API drift, and non-determinism; the paper itself observes a completeness/accuracy tradeoff.
The QA labels are imbalanced in the released CSV (1,162 Yes versus 625 No), enabling answer-prior exploitation if per-class metrics are not reported.

The HF training release has no dataset card and appears as three WebDataset archive members rather than approximately 1.4M inspectable rows; schema, row counts, hashes, and candidate/filter lineage are not documented.
Rounded counts are internally non-exact: 543k QA plus 942k descriptions is about 1.485M, while the headline says 1.4M.
Training annotations are mostly generated and VLM-filtered without human filtering, so correlated annotator errors and judge preference can survive at scale.
Source-level train/test separation cannot be independently audited from the released QA fields, and no decontamination or duplicate-transition report is provided.
Static one-step records cannot test long-horizon recovery, environment drift, reset reliability, or terminal success and must not be represented as full-episode trajectories.
Paper CC BY 4.0 does not establish permission to redistribute or train on the separate code, screenshots, annotations, or model weights.
官方基准图像快照缺少 benchmark/gen.csv 中一行（episode_12551800716657978063，步骤 2363 与 2364）的两张图像，使 250 条生成行中仅 249 条图像完整。
生成分数依赖专有 VLM 评审与提示解析；论文指定 gpt-4o-2024-08-06，而已发布评分脚本默认使用 gpt-4o-mini，除非提供评审配置。
生成评审易受冗长、幻觉、量规漂移、API 漂移与非确定性影响；论文自身观察到完整性/准确性权衡。
已发布 CSV 中 QA 标签不平衡（1,162 个 Yes 对 625 个 No），若不报告逐类指标则可能被答案先验利用。
HF 训练发布无数据集卡片，表现为三个 WebDataset 归档成员而非约 1.4M 条可检查行；schema、行计数、哈希与候选/过滤谱系未记录。
圆整计数内部不精确：543k QA 加 942k 条描述约为 1.485M，而标题称 1.4M。
训练标注大多经生成并由 VLM 过滤而无人工过滤，因此相关的标注器错误与评审偏好可在规模上存留。
无法从已发布 QA 字段独立审计来源级训练/测试分离，且未提供去污染或重复转移报告。
静态单步记录无法测试长时程恢复、环境漂移、重置可靠性或终止成功，且不得被表示为完整 episode 轨迹。
论文 CC BY 4.0 并不确立对单独代码、截图、标注或模型权重进行再分发或训练的许可。

value.html: The release derives from mobile screenshots in AiTW and Android Control, but MobileWorld provides no dataset card documenting consent, PII filtering, account/app-content handling, takedown, or redistribution rights. Human-filtering worker qualification is described, but consent and demographic/adjudication details are not.

Record-level annotator identity, candidate/rejection history, and source-to-release hashes are absent.
